title: Beef Miyeok-guk
summary: A classic Korean seaweed soup made by sautéing beef brisket and miyeok in sesame oil, then simmering until deeply savory.

steps.description: Soak the dried miyeok in cold water for about 10 minutes. Rinse it several times, squeeze out excess water, and cut it into bite-size pieces.
Pat the beef brisket dry with a paper towel and cut it into bite-size pieces.
Add the sesame oil and beef to a pot and cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes, until the outside of the beef is no longer raw.
Add the soaked miyeok and soup soy sauce, then sauté for another 2 to 3 minutes so the seaweed and beef absorb the seasoning.
Pour in the water and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to medium-low and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and simmer for 5 more minutes. Season with the salt, then turn off the heat.
